test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_dictionary_decode.parquet', Parquet) SELECT toUInt8(h % 256) AS u8, toInt16(h) AS i16, toUInt32(h * 4000037) AS u32, toInt64(h * 1000000007) AS i64, toDecimal128(h, 2) AS d128, concat('s', toString(h)) AS s FROM ( SELECT if(cityHash64(intDiv(number, 48)) % 3 = 0, cityHash64(number), cityHash64(intDiv(number, 48))) % 1000 AS h FROM numbers(50000000) ) SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
test.query: SELECT sum(u8), sum(i16) FROM file('test_parquet_dictionary_decode.parquet', Parquet) SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(u32) FROM file('test_parquet_dictionary_decode.parquet', Parquet) SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(i64) FROM file('test_parquet_dictionary_decode.parquet', Parquet) SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(d128) FROM file('test_parquet_dictionary_decode.parquet', Parquet) SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT max(s) FROM file('test_parquet_dictionary_decode.parquet', Parquet) SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
